title: Purchase and sales order agent for SAP
solves: Emailed purchase orders get read, checked against master data, raised in SAP, and acknowledged in the same thread, with a failed check never booking an order.
first_step: Send a sample batch of emailed POs so the checks can be run against your master data.

title: Order intake: AI vs EDI vs manual entry
solves: Helps you choose between manual entry, EDI, RPA and an AI agent for getting PDF, email and WhatsApp orders into your ERP.
first_step: List how orders reach you today (PDF, email, WhatsApp, EDI) and which share arrives in free text.

title: AI for SAP reporting
solves: Ask your SAP exports a question in plain language and get a traceable number, or a refusal when the data cannot answer.
first_step: Bring a folder of the SAP exports your team already downloads and the three questions asked most often.

title: AI voice agents for inbound calls
solves: Voice agents that answer every call, in English, French, Italian, Hindi and Indian languages, including after hours.
first_step: Call the live demo, then pick the one call type that repeats most for the first agent.

title: WhatsApp and Instagram AI agents
solves: Replies to WhatsApp and Instagram enquiries from your business information, books calendar slots, and hands off to your team when it matters.
first_step: Write down the ten questions customers ask most and the slots you want booked.

title: Voice and WhatsApp agents for jewellers
solves: Answers calls, follows up on WhatsApp and helps book showroom visits so enquiries do not go cold when the floor is busy.
first_step: Try the live jeweller demo, then list your showrooms and your top enquiry types.

title: AI agents for ecommerce
solves: Custom agents across voice, WhatsApp and email that read the store record to answer order questions and hand over to a person with context.
first_step: Export a week of support questions and tag how many are order-status ones.

title: TenderCraft for government tenders
solves: Reads GeM, CPPP and state tenders, checks whether you qualify before you spend, then drafts responses traced to documents you own.
first_step: Pick one open tender and gather your turnover figures, certificates and past work documents.

title: Procurement Intelligence for manufacturers
solves: Weekly demand forecasts, price bands and one recommended buying play per material, with the reasoning shown and a human approving each decision.
first_step: Pull purchase history, inventory, open POs and lead times for your five largest materials.

title: Customer Risk Intelligence
solves: Monitors every company in your B2B portfolio for adverse media, scores risk, and alerts your credit desk only when it matters.
first_step: Share your customer list so each row can be matched to a confirmed legal entity.

title: AI automation consulting
solves: Finds the workflow that pays off using your own records, then builds it and runs it in production.
first_step: List four repeating tasks with how often each runs per month and whether the rules are written down.
